title: NSS bindings configuration
description: Configuration for the bindgen invocations in build.rs. Every key corresponds to a header file in this directory (`<key>.h`, or `<key>.hpp` when `cplusplus` is set) and produces a binding file of the same name in $OUT_DIR. Items named in the `types`, `functions`, and `variables` of one header are automatically added to the `exclude` list of every other header, so each item is only generated in one module.

bindings.title: Header bindings
bindings.description: What to generate from a single header file.

opaque.description: Types that should be explicitly marked as opaque. Use this for things that are only needed in function signatures.

enums.description: Enumerations that are turned into a module. Without this, the enum is mapped using the default, which means that individual values are named <enum_type>_<enum_value_name>.

exclude.description: Items that are specifically excluded. If none of `types`, `functions`, or `variables` is specified, everything defined in the header will be mapped, so this can be used to limit that.

cplusplus.description: Whether the header is to be interpreted as C++; this selects a `.hpp` extension instead of `.h`.

itemList.description: Regular expressions matching C identifiers, which are matched in full. Entries must be sorted (build.rs asserts this) and unique.

item.description: A regular expression that is matched against the whole name of a C identifier.
